YoshTool — copy / selection-unlock test fixture

Serve over http (content scripts don't run on file://). This page blocks selection (CSS), copy/cut, right-click, drag, and Ctrl/⌘+C/A (JS). Try them first — they should all fail — then run Dev → Unlock copy & selection (or right-click → “Unlock copy & selection”) and try again.

1 · Try to SELECT this text

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Before unlocking, dragging across this paragraph selects nothing. After unlocking, it selects normally and you can copy it.

2 · Try to RIGHT-CLICK here

Right-click me — the context menu is blocked until you unlock.

3 · Try to COPY (Ctrl/⌘+C) after selecting

Even if you force a selection, copy/cut and the Ctrl+C/Ctrl+A shortcuts are cancelled until unlocked.

4 · Paste-blocked field (banks love this)

Try pasting into the field — blocked until unlocked.
